concerns.text: The plan relies on the OC20 dataset (computational DFT structures/energetics) and Materials Project bulk descriptors, but the research question is to predict experimental turnover frequency (TOF). Since no open experimental TOF dataset is available, the plan uses the DFT activation barrier as a surrogate target ("experimental TOF data are unavailable; the DFT activation barrier will serve as a surrogate target"). This constitutes a mismatch between the dataset’s target variable and the intended scientific question, making the dataset inappropriate for answering the primary research question without a clear justification or validation of the surrogate relationship.
